svg.aria-label: A table reader on a bench. A document with a ruled table lies on the left. A gantry head with a plug-in instructions cartridge reads one row. Five returned columns run to a patch panel, where each is plugged to a configured column; one returned column is capped and unmapped. The configured columns stand as bins on the right, each with a three-position Use AI knob, and four of them hold the row cards. A shelf behind holds saved training cartridges.
